ops.title: trust-verifier pool wedge: root cause and fix record (2026-07-24)
ops.body: Incident: every hook dispatch machine-wide failed as 'captain: incompatible host must be stopped before the hard cut: wire: untrusted peer' — twice (07:44:25, 19:28:58), hours each. Root cause: a verifier child timed out under load, its settlement (TERM/KILL/reap/durable-untrack via flock'd store, incl. an unconditional 500ms grace sleep) overran the fixed 1.5s reserve, stopChild -> RuntimeClaim.terminalize closed the verifier pool sticky with no reopen path; the daemon kept serving while daemonkit wire collapsed every verifier error to untrusted-peer, and launchd (KeepAlive SuccessfulExit:false) never restarts a wedged-but-alive process. Every in-band escape (shutdown/status) round-trips RuntimeHealth and self-blocks; only out-of-band restart works (launchctl kickstart -k gui/$UID/com.yasyf.captain-hook.host.v1). Do NOT delete host-v1/workers.json — it is the reaper's child-record store; startup Recover reaps stale records. Fix: daemonkit v0.19.0 (repinned in 12.20.0) makes post-activation claim terminalization fatal (RuntimeClaim.Terminalized watcher -> Wait returns error -> serve exits 1 -> launchd relaunch) and converts reaper grace sleeps to early-settle polls. Under sustained pathological load the daemon now crash-loops at ~10-40s intervals instead of wedging permanently. Correlated-but-innocent: the wn sqlite cross-thread crash (fixed same release) was a load marker, mechanistically disproven as trigger. Follow-ups: task 77017ca (consumer e2e), daemonkit task 4497f65 (move durable untrack out of the settlement reserve).
